newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles Myer says Myer Grace improving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles Myer says Myer Grace improving.

text.p: Australia's largest retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Thursday its Myer Grace Bros depart store division has taken the first steps to recovery in the first half of the 1996/97 financial year.
Earnings before interest and tax rose 27.6 percent to A$83.1 million in the 26 weeks to January 26, 1997.
Coles Myer said Myer Grace Bros sales fell 1.5 percent to A$1.71 billion, but rose 1.5 percent after an adjustment for the effect of the redevelopment of the Sydney city Grace Bros store.
"The improvement in profitabiity during the half was contrary to market trends," Coles Myer said in a commentary accompanying its first half results.
"This was achieved through lower advertising and promotion expenditure, more targetted marketing, and control of pre- and post-Christmas markdowns," it said.
Coles Myer said new developments were planned to improve profitability in the medium term, but warned second half performance remained affected by a number of issues.

These included uncertainty as to the strength of the winter apparel season, further short-term sales losses from the Sydney redevelopment, the redevelopments of the Chatswood and Southland centres, and the development of "destination categories".
